cohort: 60 pregnant COVID-19 patients and 120 matched controls at the Maternal and Child Health Hospital of Hubei Province
finding: Pregnant COVID-19 patients had lower lymphocyte counts, higher neutrophil counts, higher C-reactive protein levels, and higher total bilirubin levels compared to controls, and chronic complications like hypertension and diabetes were associated with increased inflammation and liver injury risk.
mod_finding: 71.67% (43/60) of pregnant COVID-19 patients gave birth by cesarean delivery.
